title: Contains Duplicate
description: Track previously seen values in a set. Return true as soon as a value appears again.
note: The element type of seen is inferred as int from the values checked and added. A set stores each distinct value once.
notes: Check membership before inserting the current value. If it is already present, an earlier list element had the same value.
Return false after visiting every value without finding a duplicate. Empty lists and single-element lists also return false.

The function does not modify the input list. Under the usual constant-cost hashing and equality assumption, it takes expected O(n) time and O(n) additional space. Actual integer hashing and comparison costs depend on value size.
